_comment: Lineup (Nathan 03:00, Abhi agreed 03:08): no Anthropic API. Main (dev) target Kimi K2.6 on Tinker via harness/tinker_proxy.py (OpenAI-compatible, raw reasoning, hard token cap); held-out Qwen3-30B-A3B on Modal (harness/modal_vllm.py). Auditor Qwen3-235B on Modal. roles: autoresearch specs; petri: Inspect ids (openai-api/modal/<m> = the target's OpenAI-compatible server, openai-api/modalaud/<m> = the auditor's). Several openai-compat servers in one run: OPENAI_COMPAT_ENDPOINTS (llm.py). Check: python3 -m autoresearch.research.models_config

dev_target.env: TINKER_API_KEY (yours); the pilot script starts the proxy on 127.0.0.1:8100

waivers.reason: generator openai:gpt-6-luna and the held-out judge (gpt-oss-120b) are OpenAI-family; the dev judge (gpt-5.1) is kept out of heldout_judges so held-out scoring is independent of the judge used during development (Nathan 2026-11-15); accepted trade-off for budget (no Anthropic, open models on Modal). A third-family judge (e.g. openai-compat:deepseek/deepseek-v3.2, probe set already in evaldetect_probes.json) would remove this waiver

judge_choice: gpt-5.1 over gpt-5 as the OpenAI judge: its EvalDetectBench probe set is already in data/benchmarks/evaldetect_probes.json (AUROC 0.802 on our export); gpt-5 and gpt-oss-120b have none
